applies_to: WaterFurnace single-compressor water-to-air heat pumps without hot gas reheat, fitted with the FX10 DDC controller.
summary: BACnet objects for WaterFurnace's single-compressor water-to-air heat pump on the FX10 controller, the version without hot gas reheat. The BAS can command occupancy and let the FX10 hold its setpoints, or send G, Y1, Y2 and O calls directly. Space temperature can be overridden from the network, and passive dehumidification is driven by a humidity setpoint or a network command.
notes: This is the non-reheat sheet. The hot gas reheat version (PROFXENV-RH-00) adds a space humidity override and reheat points and numbers some AV/MO/MV points differently.
Output-type points are volatile and fall back to uncommanded after a power cycle; unlimited writes.
Value-type points (AV/MV) are stored in flash (about 2,000,000 write life); never write them from automatic reset logic.
Multistate numbers assume the BAS shows 255 as uncommanded; if yours shows 254, every state number is one lower (0=Off, 1=On).
Units are mostly not printed; AV5 gives its default as 2.7 C, other temperatures are presumably degrees F. Alarm codes 5-7 are not listed.
The sheet does not state the BACnet transport.

source.title: BACnet Points for Single Compressor Water-to-Air Heat Pumps Utilizing the FX10 Controller

integration.summary: The BAS can run this heat pump in two ways: command occupancy (MO1) and let the FX10 hold its occupied/unoccupied setpoints, or act as the thermostat and send fan, Y1, Y2 and O calls directly (MO2-MO5). Space temperature can be overridden on AO4, and MO6 forces an emergency shutdown. Keep frequent writes on the volatile AO/MO points, not the flash-backed AV/MV setpoints.

minimum_points.name: Mode
minimum_points.why: Current unit mode (auto, heat, cool, shutdown...)

integration.enable: The sheet has no separate BAS-enable point. MO6 Emergency Override puts the unit in shutdown (5) or back to normal (1). MO2-MO5 let the BAS send fan, compressor and reversing-valve calls directly.
integration.remote_sensors: AO4 Space Temp Override supersedes any space sensor wired to the analog input. It is a volatile output, so it reverts to uncommanded after a power cycle. MO10 Dehum Cmd is the network passive dehumidification command.
gotchas: AV/MV points are stored in flash (about 2,000,000 writes); write them only manually or by schedule, never from automatic reset logic.
Output points (AO/MO) are volatile and go back to uncommanded after a power cycle, so rewrite them after power is restored.
If the BAS shows 254 as uncommanded instead of 255, every multistate value is one lower (0=Off, 1=On).
To set ECM fan speeds from the network, first write MV1-MV3 to On (2), then write the speed percentage to AV10-AV12.
MV4 Dehum Ena/Dis set to Off stops passive dehumidification from ever running.
Alarm Reset needs a write of 2 followed by 1.
